subject: Michael Gammariello Endorsement of Anna Callahan
overview: Michael Gammariello spoke in support of Anna Callahan's candidacy for State Representative for the 34th Middlesex District during a campaign launch event.

items.title: Endorsement Remarks by Michael Gammariello
items.summary: Michael Gammariello shared personal experiences living in a housing co-op with Anna Callahan and endorsed her campaign for State Representative.
